hooks.rejectedMessage: A Git hook rejected the action.

intro.granted: When the window is not in the foreground, they also arrive as system notifications.
intro.blocked: System notifications are blocked for this app – messages only appear in the window.
intro.unknown: When the window is not in the foreground, they also arrive as system notifications – the first time, the system asks for permission.

granted.label: Allowed
granted.text: The system shows notifications from this app. They only arrive when the window is not in the foreground and one of the switches above is on. Clicking a notification does not bring the window to the front by itself.

blocked.label: Blocked by the system
blocked.text: The system does not allow notifications from this app. Allow them in the system settings (Notifications) and reopen this section.

unknown.label: Not asked yet
unknown.text: The system has not been asked for permission yet. That happens with the first notification – or now with “Send test”.

system.title: System notifications
system.sent: Sent – it now appears as a system notification.
